title: toxicodendron trilobatum
intro: Toxicodendron trilobatum, commonly known as the Fire Tree or Poison Ash, is a plant species belonging to the Anacardiaceae family. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which have been shown to exhibit analgesic, anti-cancer, and immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Toxicodendron trilobatum have been identified to include flavonoids like kaempferol, quercetin, and isorhapontigenin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
